name: What is the difference between a curbless shower and a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a curbless shower and a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: While often used interchangeably, there's a key distinction. A walk-in shower typically features a low curb or threshold that you step over to enter. In contrast, a curbless shower eliminates this barrier entirely, creating a completely flush entry from the bathroom floor directly into the shower space. This makes curbless showers inherently more accessible. Both designs offer spaciousness and a modern look, but the curbless option provides superior ease of access and a more seamless aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: A curbless shower has no threshold, offering a flush entry, while a walk-in shower usually has a low curb. Curbless provides greater accessibility.
